topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflector gain loss reduces antenna gain, increasing spillover loss and broadening patterns, resulting in a 6 dB gain loss. This degradation affects SNR margins and capacity. Optimization of reflector surface and feed array can mitigate effects, but adds complexity. Adaptive beamforming algorithms can also help maintain link budget performance.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors suffer from gain loss and broadened patterns, while optimization and adaptive beamforming can mitigate these effects.
